title: T-8: a client leaves to the menu while the game's logo maker is mid-render - the routine ends cleanly ('logo maker stopped') instead of faulting on the cleared save or the destroyed GlobalReferences
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus/Prabaha, client Client1/REX). Dev build with DevT8 (logoregen lever) and the T-8 logo-routine prefix deployed. The client's renders go to a scratch folder under the game's temporary cache; the save is not written. Ends with both instances dropped.

oracles_present.regex: \[Patcher\] logo maker stopped: the city is gone \((no save|no GlobalReferences)\)

steps.note: the host's own settle line, searched from the hostload step
the client's settle line, searched from its join step
DevT8 lever: 120 renders handed to the game's own logo maker; each takes several frames, so the chain is still running at the next step

expect_log.regex: \[Patcher\] logo maker stopped: the city is gone

steps.note: sent at once: the game loads the menu before it unloads the city, so the in-flight routine steps after the save is cleared / GlobalReferences is destroyed
the city unload completes; any late fault lands in the log before teardown
